carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with specular highlights on the upper edge and shadowed regions below.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of small high-luminance blobs along the leading edge, transitioning to larger, more sparse spots towards the posterior margin.
